name: zrndr_global_string_table_release_dynamic_entries
description: zRndr::GlobalStringTable_ReleaseDynamicEntries frees dynamic global-string table entries above the six built-in base slots, clears those entries, resets the count to six, and returns.
known_limits: Tier C only; no accepted VC COFF byte comparison exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The free-provider call is validated by using heap-owned dynamic entries and verifying the table slots are cleared after release.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x480ec0 has no current warnings and validates count read, built-in base slot threshold 6, free-provider call for entries starting at index 6, pointer clearing, count reset to 6, and zeroed EAX on return.
The dependency frontier for 0x480ec0 reports no visible source blockers; the only indirect call is the imported free provider loaded from the runtime boundary.

Native smoke zrndr_global_string_table_release_dynamic_entries_smoke verifies entries 6 and 7 are released and cleared when the count is 8, base entries 0 and 5 are preserved, entry 8 outside the count is untouched, and the count-less-than-six path still resets the count to 6 without touching entry 6.
